title: Sync firmware/bridge-zephyr vendored lichen_l2 copy with jfzk error-code changes (LICHEN_ESCHC, ENOKEY=126, crash_info skip)
description: Found by security review pass of project-LICHEN-worker6-jfzk (P2). firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/lichen_l2.c is a vendored copy of the L2 tx path and still carries the pre-jfzk behavior its parent bead fixed: (1) crash_info_store(CRASH_STATE_CORRUPTION) for every negative lichen_link_tx return - policy rejections (-LICHEN_ESCHC semantics) and keyless state (-ENOKEY) are mislabeled as corruption there (:87-96 area); (2) its local to_zephyr_errno leaks raw SCHC/201 codes to the Zephyr net stack (:989-993 area); (3) its vendored lichen_util.h strerror lacks the new cases. Fix: mirror the jfzk edits - LICHEN_ESCHC (201) in its errno header, the policy-rejection mapping in lichen_link_tx's compress step, the crash_info skip for -LICHEN_ESCHC/-ENOKEY, the -EINVAL Zephyr mapping, and the strerror cases - or re-vendor the updated files wholesale if the vendored tree tracks upstream files 1:1. Verify the bridge-zephyr firmware builds for its target (Zephyr env required - not available on heft, see the v3.7.0 tree note) before closing.
